'''R6-D0''' was the designation of a [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] residing on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It relayed to Imperial forces a transmission from [[Darth Malgus]] regarding the [[Mission to Athiss|situation]] on [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]].<ref name="TOR" />
